claim: Live drives that use real Haiku turns can take from about 4 minutes to over 9 minutes and can stall, so the spec should state the expected duration so reviewers can budget a turn for it.

citations.quote: Live drives that use real Haiku turns can take anywhere from about 4 minutes to over 9 minutes, and can stall.
